items.text: The Demo Catheter DC-100 is a single-lumen, 5 Fr peripheral catheter with a polycarbonate luer hub, a polyurethane shaft and a radiopaque tip. It is supplied sterile for single use.
Principle of operation: the catheter is advanced over a 0.035 in guidewire; fluids are delivered through the luer hub. The device has no powered components and no software.
Ethylene oxide sterilization was validated by the overkill half-cycle method per ISO 11135. All biological indicators in the half cycle were negative, supporting a sterility assurance level of 10^-6.
Ethylene oxide and ethylene chlorohydrin residuals were measured per ISO 10993-7 after the routine aeration period; all results were below the tolerable contact limits for a limited-exposure device.
Packaged samples are aged at 55 C per ASTM F1980 to simulate 2 years of real-time shelf life, then tested for seal strength and package integrity.
Dye penetration: 0 of 60 aged pouches showed channels. Seal strength mean 1.4 N/15 mm, minimum 1.1 N/15 mm.
In vitro cytotoxicity per ISO 10993-5 (MEM elution): the test article extract scored grade 0; the device is non-cytotoxic.

The DC-100 is an externally communicating device in contact with circulating blood for limited duration (under 24 h). Endpoints per ISO 10993-1: cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation, acute systemic toxicity, hemocompatibility and material-mediated pyrogenicity.
Hemolysis (direct and indirect contact) per ASTM F756: hemolytic index 0.4%, classified non-hemolytic.
Guinea pig maximization test: none of the test animals showed a sensitization response; the extract is not a sensitizer.
Mean peak tensile force of the shaft-to-hub bond was 42.0 N (n = 30), above the 15 N acceptance criterion.
Gravity flow rate with saline at 100 cm head height: mean 32 mL/min, all samples within the labeled 28-36 mL/min range.
Kink resistance: no lumen occlusion at a 10 mm bend radius. Torque to failure exceeded 0.05 N·m for all samples.
Small-bore luer connector testing per ISO 80369-7: leakage, separation from axial load and resistance to overriding all passed.
Radiated and conducted emissions met CISPR 11 Group 1 Class B limits; immunity tests per IEC 60601-1-2 passed with no loss of essential performance.
Leakage currents, dielectric strength and protective earth impedance were tested per IEC 60601-1; all results within limits for a Type BF applied part.
The controller firmware schedules infusion steps and raises occlusion alarms. Its development followed IEC 62304; a failure could lead to under-infusion, so the documentation level is Enhanced.
Unit and integration tests: 412 executed, 412 passed. Anomalies open at release: 3, all assessed as not affecting safety.
Instructions for use: flush the catheter with sterile saline before insertion. Do not resterilize. Do not use if the pouch is damaged. Rx only.
Label: Demo Catheter DC-100, 5 Fr x 20 cm. STERILE EO. Single use. Use-by date and lot number. Manufacturer: Fictional Medical Ltd.
